corsicanacare-essentials-10-in-gel-infus.name: CorsicanaCare Essentials 10" Gel Infused Mattress - Residential/ Bed N Box
corsicanacare-essentials-10-in-gel-infus.description: Mattress Cover Quilted Mattress Cover Delivery The mattress is compressed and rolled for quick small parcel delivery. Nationwide Drop shipping Delivery within 3-5 Business Days. Setup Placement: Before opening, place the mattress on a proper surface such as a continuously solid surface, an adjustable base, or slats no more than two (2) inches apart capable of supporting the mattress and users. Unwrap: Use scissors to unwrap and unroll the mattress from the plastic; DO NOT USE A RAZOR BLADE. Expand: Allow the mattress to expand. The mattress may take up to 72 hours to fully recover and return to its original shape.
features: The mattress is compressed and rolled for quick small parcel delivery.
Nationwide Drop shipping
Delivery within 3-5 Business Days.

Placement: Before opening, place the mattress on a proper surface such as a continuously solid surface, an adjustable base, or slats no more than two (2) inches apart capable of supporting the mattress and users.
Unwrap: Use scissors to unwrap and unroll the mattress from the plastic; DO NOT USE A RAZOR BLADE.

Expand: Allow the mattress to expand. The mattress may take up to 72 hours to fully recover and return to its original shape. You can sleep on it immediately; the body heat and movement will expedite recovery.
The mattress cover is machine-washable; wash on a cold, gentle cycle with like colors and air dry without heat.
Do not dry clean, bleach, iron, or steam.
Rotate your mattress to give uniform wear to the sleeping surface.
Do not stand or jump on the mattress.
